rdfs:label: qualifiedDerivation
rdfs:comment: A qualified PROV Derivation linked to the entity — qualifies wasDerivedFrom with the Activity (prov:hadActivity), the Usage of the source (prov:hadUsage) and the Generation of the result (prov:hadGeneration).
notes: Use to attach a `urn:solid:Derivation` resource that qualifies the basic `urn:solid:wasDerivedFrom` link with the Activity (`prov:hadActivity`), the Usage of the source (`prov:hadUsage`) and the Generation of the result (`prov:hadGeneration`). Pattern: when you need richer derivation metadata, keep both the unqualified `wasDerivedFrom` triple (for SPARQL convenience) AND the qualified form.

history.note: Comment/notes list the real Derivation qualifiers (hadActivity, hadUsage, hadGeneration) instead of role/plan; seeAlso adds them.
